text_en: Come down and sit in the dust, virgin daughter Babylon! Sit on the ground without a throne, daughter Chaldea! For you shall no more be called tender and delicate.
text_cn: 巴比伦处女！下去，坐在尘土中吧！加色丁贞女！让位，坐在地上吧！因为你已不再称为“娇媚”“柔嫩”了。

text_en: Take the millstones and grind meal, remove your veil, strip off your robe, uncover your legs, pass through the rivers.
text_cn: 揭去面纱，拿磨去磨面吧！卷起长裙，露出大腿去涉河吧！

text_en: Your nakedness shall be uncovered, and your shame shall be seen. I will take vengeance, and I will spare no one.
text_cn: 你的裸体要暴露，你的羞耻要现出！我要复仇，决不怜惜任何人。

text_en: Our Redeemer—the Lord of hosts is his name— is the Holy One of Israel.
text_cn: 我们的救主──他的名字是万军的上主──说。

text_en: Sit in silence, and go into darkness, daughter Chaldea! For you shall no more be called the mistress of kingdoms.
text_cn: 加色丁处女！静静地坐下：进入黑暗中吧！因为你不再称为“万国之后！”

text_en: I was angry with my people, I profaned my heritage; I gave them into your hand, you showed them no mercy; on the aged you made your yoke exceedingly heavy.
text_cn: 我曾向我的人民发怒，污辱了我的产业；我将他们交在你手中，可是你对他们没有表示仁慈，将你的轭（è）重重地压在老者身上。

text_en: You said, “I shall be mistress forever, ” so that you did not lay these things to heart or remember their end.
text_cn: 你说过：“我永久要作王后！”但你心中从没有考虑过这事，也没有想过这事的结局。

text_en: Now therefore hear this, you lover of pleasures, who sit securely, who say in your heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me; I shall not sit as a widow or know the loss of children”—
text_cn: 你这淫逸安居的人，你心里想：“只有我而没有别人！我决不会寡居，也决不会丧子！”如今你听这话：

text_en: both these things shall come upon you in a moment, in one day: the loss of children and widowhood shall come upon you in full measure, in spite of your many sorceries and the great power of your enchantments.
text_cn: 这两样在一天内会突然一起降在你身上；虽然你能行许多巫术，能念极威力的符咒，丧子与守寡仍要完全降到你身上。

text_en: You felt secure in your wickedness; you said, “No one sees me. ” Your wisdom and your knowledge led you astray, and you said in your heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me. ”
text_cn: 你自恃于恶说：“没有人看见我！”那是你的聪明和知识迷惑了你，叫你心中妄想：“只有我而没有别人。”

text_en: But evil shall come upon you, which you cannot charm away; disaster shall fall upon you, which you will not be able to ward off; and ruin shall come on you suddenly, of which you know nothing.
text_cn: 灾祸必要临到你身上，你却不能禳（ráng）灾；患难要降在你身上，但你不能阻止；你从未料到的灭亡，要突然来到你身上。

text_en: Stand fast in your enchantments and your many sorceries, with which you have labored from your youth; perhaps you may be able to succeed, perhaps you may inspire terror.
text_cn: 请你继续行你自幼即劳碌习行的咒术和那无数的巫术吧！这或许能于你有利，或者能叫人害怕。

text_en: You are wearied with your many consultations; let those who study the heavens stand up and save you, those who gaze at the stars, and at each new moon predict what shall befall you.
text_cn: 你也许听倦了那许多计谋，现在让那些测天体，观星辰和每月预告你未来之事的人们前来拯救你吧！

text_en: See, they are like stubble, the fire consumes them; they cannot deliver themselves from the power of the flame. No coal for warming oneself is this, no fire to sit before!
text_cn: 看哪！他们都像枯草，必为火所焚烧；他们连自己也不能由火的威力中救出，因为这不是为取煖的炭火，也不是座前的炉火。

text_en: Such to you are those with whom you have labored, who have trafficked with you from your youth; they all wander about in their own paths; there is no one to save you.
text_cn: 你那些自幼与之共同劳碌的巫士，为你都是如此；他们各散东西，没有谁来救你。
